suggestions: I'm grateful for a pull request that got approved with zero comments, for once.
I'm thankful for the azan drifting in through the window while I'm still half asleep.
I'm grateful for figuring out the root cause was a stale cache and not my own logic.
I'm thankful for roti canai that's crispy on the edges and soft right in the middle.
I'm grateful for a standup that actually lasted fifteen minutes like it was supposed to.
I'm thankful for my dad still calling just to ask about traffic, nothing else.
I'm grateful for the aircon in the office working again after three days of sweating through meetings.
I'm thankful for the LRT actually arriving on time when I'm already running late.
I'm grateful for a staging environment that caught the bug before it reached anyone's phone.
I'm thankful for the break after Maghrib when the whole house finally slows down.
I'm grateful for a senior dev who explained the legacy code instead of just telling me to figure it out.
I'm thankful for duit raya memories popping up on my feed and making me smile mid-scrum.
I'm grateful for a laptop that didn't decide to update itself right before a demo.
I'm thankful for the mechanic being honest about what actually needed fixing on the car.
I'm grateful for a Friday where the last ticket closed before the adhan for Jumaat.
